name: Nicolasa Cedillo — death in May 1943, Santa Lucía, Intibucá, Honduras
researcher_question: When and where did Nicolasa Cedillo die? She was the wife of Santiago Cedillo, and their children were baptised between 1899 and 1914 in Camasca and neighbouring parishes of southern Intibucá and Lempira, Honduras.
